subject: maths
question: The falling height of an object is directly proportional to the square of the time. An object falls 80 cm in 4 seconds. Then in 8 seconds, from how much height (in cm) will the object fall?
solution:
**Given:**

The height fallen (h) is directly proportional to the square of the time (t²).

Height fallen in 4 seconds = 80 cm

Time = 8 seconds

**Formula used:**

h₁ / h₂ = t₁² / t₂²

**Calculation:**

Let the height fallen in 8 seconds be h₂.

80 / h₂ = 4²&
lt;/sup> / ⁸²

80 / h₂ = 16 / 64

80 / h₂ = 1 / 4

⇒ h₂ = 80 × 4

⇒ h₂ = 320 cm

**∴ The object will fall from a height of 320 cm in 8 seconds.**
